# AI Hub Platform — agent integration index

Read this file first when integrating an independent application with the AI Hub platform.

## Start here

1. docs/agent-integration.md — reading order, decision tree, env vars, checklists
2. docs/developer-integration-guide.md — human-oriented integration guide (API-only, DATA_INGEST, certification)
3. contracts/api/platform-api.openapi.yaml — platform public API (v0.2.1+)

## Developer assets (also via API)

Base URL: {PLATFORM}/portal-api/v1/developer/assets/{asset_id}

| asset_id | path |
| --- | --- |
| agent-integration | docs/agent-integration.md |
| integration-guide | docs/developer-integration-guide.md |
| platform-openapi | contracts/api/platform-api.openapi.yaml |
| api-only-python | examples/sdk/api_only.py |
| data-read-python | examples/sdk/data_read.py |
| data-ingest-evidence | examples/sdk/data_ingest_evidence.py |

Catalog: GET {PLATFORM}/portal-api/v1/developer/catalog

## App-side export (NOT in platform OpenAPI)

DATA_INGEST apps must implement:

GET {app}/ai-hub/export?object_type=&since_version=&limit=

Scope: ai_hub.ingest.export. Schema: sdk/python/src/ai_hub_sdk/export.py (ExportPage).

## Manual steps (cannot be automated via API)

Application registration, client_secret issuance, and conformance runs in the portal governance UI.
